name: Report to PowerPoint
description: Takes a screenshot of each Report tab in the input and makes a PowerPoint file with one slide per tab.
introductoryText:
![Project metadata block feeding Report to PowerPoint](data:image/png;base64,)

Takes a screenshot of each Report tab (or other web page) whose URL is in the input, and makes one PowerPoint file with a slide per screenshot, in input order. Use it after a **Project metadata** block, which lists each Report tab with its URL.

**How to set it up**: choose the field with the URLs, the screenshot size and orientation, the output folder and the file name (`report.pptx` if left empty). The slides take the shape of the screenshots (the long side 13.33 inches, as in PowerPoint's widescreen slide), and each screenshot fills its slide. The PNG files are kept beside the PowerPoint file (`screenshot_0.png`, ...).

The output has one record per slide: the URL, the PNG's path and file name, and the PowerPoint file's path. Records with an empty URL are skipped.

**What it needs.** Chrome, driven by the `visokio-omniprint` Python package (installed on first run). On a server that runs custom blocks in Docker, the block uses its own image with Chrome included ([Docker setup](https://help.visokio.com/support/solutions/articles/42000071133-setting-up-the-custom-block)); otherwise Chrome must be installed on the machine running Omniscope. Each page must be reachable from that machine.

**Authentication.** For pages behind Basic Authentication (for example a Report with Local Desktop Experience turned off), enter a username and password. They are used only to open the page; they are not written to the output.

options.name: url_field
options.title: URL field
options.description: The field holding the address of each Report tab (or other page) to put on a slide.

options.name: resolution
options.title: Screenshot size
options.description: The size of each screenshot in pixels: Chrome's page area is set to this size (turned on its side for Portrait).

options.name: orientation
options.title: Orientation
options.description: Landscape: wider than tall, as listed. Portrait: the same size turned on its side.

options.name: folder_path
options.title: Output folder
options.description: The folder the PowerPoint file and the PNG screenshots are saved in, on the machine running Omniscope. Created if missing; files with the same names are replaced.

options.name: sleep_seconds
options.title: Page load delay (seconds)
options.description: Extra seconds to wait after the page has finished loading, before the screenshot. Raise it if charts come out half drawn.

options.name: tinify
options.title: Shrink with Tinify
options.description: Shrinks each PNG to the width below with the Tinify web service (api.tinify.com), which needs an API key: https://tinify.com/dashboard/api. The screenshots are uploaded to Tinify, so leave it unticked for confidential Reports.

options.name: tinify_width
options.title: Shrunk width (pixels)
options.description: Needed with Shrink with Tinify. The height keeps the screenshot's proportions.

options.name: output_file_name
options.title: PowerPoint file name
options.description: Optional. Empty: report.pptx. .pptx is added if missing.

options.name: auth_username
options.title: Username
options.description: Optional. For pages behind Basic Authentication.

options.name: auth_password
options.title: Password
options.description: Optional. Used only to open the page; not written to the output.

blockOutputs.label: Slides
blockOutputs.tooltip: One record per slide: URL, Screenshot path, Screenshot filename, PowerPoint file.
